menu:6058830:1.text: Hi, I'm Sophia! Do you know how to ice skate?
menu:6058830:1.source_cn: 你好！我叫索菲娅，你会滑冰吗？

menu:6058860:1.text: It's time to give it our all!
menu:6058860:1.source_cn: 这次我们要认真起来了！

menu:6058890:1.text: I don't want to go home...

say:1:1322553001:1.text: I feel a bit bad, though... I've been so buried in duchy affairs that I haven't had a chance to check in on the kids in Cedartown, even though I've been in town all this time.
say:1:1322553001:1.source_cn: 说起来有些不好意思，我虽然身处雪松镇，可处理公国事务实...
say:1:1322553001:1.male: I feel a bit bad, though... I've been so buried in duchy affairs that I haven't had a chance to check in on the kids in Cedartown, even though I've been in town all this time.
say:1:1322553001:1.female: I feel a bit bad, though... I've been so buried in duchy affairs that I haven't had a chance to check in on the kids in Cedartown, even though I've been in town all this time.

say:2:1322553002:1.text: Magister, the kids here adore you. Would you mind going to check on them? I'd really appreciate it.
say:2:1322553002:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，您似乎很讨孩子们喜欢，能劳烦您前往过去探望...
say:2:1322553002:1.male: Magister, the kids here adore you. Would you mind going to check on them? I'd really appreciate it.
say:2:1322553002:1.female: Magister, the kids here adore you. Would you mind going to check on them? I'd really appreciate it.

say:3:1322553003:1.text: And if anything comes up, just let me know.
say:3:1322553003:1.source_cn: 如果有什么问题，还麻烦您及时通知我。
say:3:1322553003:1.male: And if anything comes up, just let me know.
say:3:1322553003:1.female: And if anything comes up, just let me know.

say:0:1322554001:0.text: Whoa, look at that! The kids are ice skating! That looks like a blast.
say:0:1322554001:0.source_cn: 哇，快看，孩子们在滑冰！好有趣啊！

say:1:1322555001:1.text: Everyone around here can skate, but no one can agree on who's the best. Since we're all skilled, we're too proud to admit anyone else is better!
say:1:1322555001:1.source_cn: 我们白山所有的人都会滑冰，只是不知道谁最厉害。因为大家...

say:2:1322555002:1.text: Hey mister, you're a stranger, but you look like you know your stuff on the ice.
say:2:1322555002:1.male: Hey mister, you're a stranger, but you look like you know your stuff on the ice.
say:2:1322555002:1.female: Hey miss, you're a stranger, but you look like you know your stuff on the ice.

say:3:1322555003:1.source_cn: 想要和我们比试一下吗？

say:1:1322556001:1.text: Okay, okay, you're really good. But skating's just the start... we've got something even better for you.
say:1:1322556001:1.source_cn: 嗯……好吧，我们承认你滑冰很厉害！但是……光滑冰厉害可不行。
say:1:1322556001:1.male: Okay, okay, you're really good. But skating's just the start... we've got something even better for you.
say:1:1322556001:1.female: Okay, okay, you're really good. But skating's just the start... we've got something even better for you.

say:2:1322556002:1.text: How about a snowball fight? You in?
say:2:1322556002:1.source_cn: 你敢不敢和我们玩一场雪球大战呢？
say:2:1322556002:1.male: How about a snowball fight? You in?
say:2:1322556002:1.female: How about a snowball fight? You in?

say:3:1322556003:1.text: Heehee, we're experts at this! You won't know what hit you!
say:3:1322556003:1.source_cn: 嘿，这可是我们的拿手好戏！

say:1:1322557001:1.text: See that? This is our kingdom!
say:1:1322557001:1.source_cn: 看到了吗？这里可是我们的王国！

say:2:1322557002:1.text: And anyone who can stand tall in a blizzard is a true warrior. So...
say:2:1322557002:1.source_cn: 我们觉得能在暴雪中保持站立的人才是真正的勇士！所以……

say:5:1322557004:1.text: Whoa, right in Chippy's face! Guess the Magister is gonna have to fight back now!
say:5:1322557004:1.source_cn: 哎呀，好准！都砸到满满脸上了……看来主人也得认真回击了！
say:5:1322557004:1.male: Whoa, right in Chippy's face! Guess the Magister is gonna have to fight back now!
say:5:1322557004:1.female: Whoa, right in Chippy's face! Guess the Magister is gonna have to fight back now!

say:1:1322558001:1.text: Didn't expect you to be so good at snowball fights, too! Alright, consider me impressed.
say:1:1322558001:1.source_cn: 没想到你玩雪球大战也那么厉害！好吧，我这次心服口服。
say:1:1322558001:1.male: Didn't expect you to be so good at snowball fights, too! Alright, consider me impressed.
say:1:1322558001:1.female: Didn't expect you to be so good at snowball fights, too! Alright, consider me impressed.

say:2:1322558002:0.text: Alright, I've decided! From today on, you're our new King! Haha!
say:2:1322558002:0.source_cn: 我决定了，从今天起，你是我们的新大王！哈哈……
say:2:1322558002:0.male: Alright, I've decided! From today on, you're our new King! Haha!
say:2:1322558002:0.female: Alright, I've decided! From today on, you're our new King! Haha!

say:3:1322558003:1.text: But... ugh, I'm starving. Time to head home for some food. Later, King!
say:3:1322558003:1.source_cn: 不过……唔，肚子饿了，我们得回家吃饭了。大王，再见！
say:3:1322558003:1.male: But... ugh, I'm starving. Time to head home for some food. Later, King!
say:3:1322558003:1.female: But... ugh, I'm starving. Time to head home for some food. Later, King!

say:0:1322559001:0.text: Hey, wait a second, is that Sofio? Why hasn't she gone home to eat yet?
say:0:1322559001:0.source_cn: 咦，那不是索菲娅吗？她怎么还没回家吃饭？

say:1:1322560001:1.text: Sofio! What are you still doing here? Shouldn't you be home for lunch?
say:1:1322560001:1.source_cn: 索菲娅，你怎么还没有回家吃饭呢？

say:2:1322560002:1.text: Hey, King... are you gonna leave Cedartown? Does that mean we can't hang out anymore?
say:2:1322560002:1.source_cn: 大王，你是不是总会离开雪松镇啊？这样是不是就没办法再陪...
say:2:1322560002:1.male: Hey, King... are you gonna leave Cedartown? Does that mean we can't hang out anymore?
say:2:1322560002:1.female: Hey, King... are you gonna leave Cedartown? Does that mean we can't hang out anymore?

say:3:1322560003:0.text: In that case... I'll make a snowman... A snowman that represents you, King! 'Cause I've never met anyone as awesome as you!
say:3:1322560003:0.source_cn: 所以……我、我想堆一个雪人！代表大王的雪人！因为我从来...
say:3:1322560003:0.male: In that case... I'll make a snowman... A snowman that represents you, King! 'Cause I've never met anyone as awesome as you!
say:3:1322560003:0.female: In that case... I'll make a snowman... A snowman that represents you, King! 'Cause I've never met anyone as awesome as you!

say:4:1322560004:1.text: But... I'm too hungry to make it on my own. You've gotta help, King!
say:4:1322560004:1.source_cn: 不过，我太饿了，没有力气，大王你也要一起来帮忙喔！
say:4:1322560004:1.male: But... I'm too hungry to make it on my own. You've gotta help, King!
say:4:1322560004:1.female: But... I'm too hungry to make it on my own. You've gotta help, King!

say:1:1322561001:1.text: Wow, this snowman is perfect! You really are the King!
say:1:1322561001:1.source_cn: 不愧是大王，这个雪人太漂亮了！
say:1:1322561001:1.male: Wow, this snowman is perfect! You really are the King!
say:1:1322561001:1.female: Wow, this snowman is perfect! You really are the King!

say:2:1322561002:1.text: If you can't come play with me tomorrow, I'll just hang out with the snowman. He'll be the stand-in.
say:2:1322561002:1.source_cn: 我想，如果明天大王不能来陪我玩的话，就让雪人来代替吧。
say:2:1322561002:1.male: If you can't come play with me tomorrow, I'll just hang out with the snowman. He'll be the stand-in.
say:2:1322561002:1.female: If you can't come play with me tomorrow, I'll just hang out with the snowman. He'll be the stand-in.

say:3:1322561003:1.text: But, okay, seriously, I've gotta run home for lunch. I'll miss you, though. See you!
say:3:1322561003:1.source_cn: 不过我真的要回家吃饭了，我会想念你的，再见……
say:3:1322561003:1.male: But, okay, seriously, I've gotta run home for lunch. I'll miss you, though. See you!
say:3:1322561003:1.female: But, okay, seriously, I've gotta run home for lunch. I'll miss you, though. See you!

say:1:1322562001:1.text: I've been worried about how the kids would be affected by the whole Hypogean mess, but hearing that puts me at ease. As long as they're healthy, that's all that matters. They're the future of Whiteridge, after all.
say:1:1322562001:1.source_cn: 我一直担心孩子们会在这次恶魔事件中受到影响，听您这么说...

say:2:1322562002:1.text: I really appreciate you taking the time to help. I'll keep doing my best to handle the duchy's day-to-day affairs. With your help, we'll restore peace here in no time.
say:2:1322562002:1.source_cn: 感谢您百忙之中伸出援手。我一定会努力处理好公国的日常事...
say:2:1322562002:1.male: I really appreciate you taking the time to help. I'll keep doing my best to handle the duchy's day-to-day affairs. With your help, we'll restore peace here in no time.
say:2:1322562002:1.female: I really appreciate you taking the time to help. I'll keep doing my best to handle the duchy's day-to-day affairs. With your help, we'll restore peace here in no time.
